## How to run the course code

Each lecture note gives you two ways to get its files to Claude.

**Path 1 — upload the files.** Each lab has a downloadable pack holding
exactly the files it needs. Download one file, unzip it, drag the contents into
a new Claude conversation, and paste the note's Path 1 prompt. This works on
every Claude account, including the free tier.

| Lab | Pack | Files |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Chapter 1 pack](upload_packs/lab-1-chapter-01.zip) | 4 |
| 2 | [Chapter 2 pack](upload_packs/lab-2-chapter-02.zip) | 5 |
| 3 | [Chapter 3 pack](upload_packs/lab-3-chapter-03.zip) | 11 |
| 4 | [Chapter 4 pack](upload_packs/lab-4-chapter-04.zip) | 6 |
| 5 | [Chapter 5 pack](upload_packs/lab-5-chapter-05.zip) | 6 |
| 6 | [Chapter 6 pack](upload_packs/lab-6-chapter-06.zip) | 7 |
| 7 | [Chapter 7 pack](upload_packs/lab-7-chapter-07.zip) | 8 |
| 8–9 | [Chapters 8–9 pack](upload_packs/lab-8-chapters-08-09.zip) | 9 |
| 10 | [Chapter 10 pack](upload_packs/lab-10-chapter-10.zip) | 7 |
| 16a | [Forecasting 1 pack](upload_packs/lab-16a-forecasting-1.zip) | 6 |
| 16b | [Forecasting 2 pack](upload_packs/lab-16b-forecasting-2.zip) | 8 |
| 16c | [Forecasting 3 pack](upload_packs/lab-16c-forecasting-3.zip) | 8 |
| 16 data | [Data-tools pack](upload_packs/lab-16-data-tools.zip) | 4 |

**Path 2 — let Claude fetch them.** If your account's web access is on, you can
skip the downloading and name the repository instead:

> Get the MBA 775 course materials from
> <https://github.com/jcrooker/mba775>. I need `scripts/01a_inspect_dff.py`,
> `scripts/_course.py`, and `data/dff.csv`. Read
> `COURSE_CONTEXT.md` from the same repository first — it explains how this
> course expects analytical work to be done.
>
> Run the script and show me its actual output, verbatim. Then walk me through
> what each section does and what the results mean. Do not report any number
> you did not compute, and if anything fails, show me the error rather than
> describing what the output would have been.
>
> If you cannot reach GitHub, tell me plainly and I will upload the files
> instead.

If Claude answers that it cannot reach GitHub, nothing is wrong. Web access is
a per-account setting, and even when it is on, Claude cannot always retrieve a
file by direct link. Use Path 1 — the Chapter 1 note explains how to check the
setting and walks through the upload route step by step.

## Using AI in this course

Claude is expected and encouraged everywhere except exams, which are in person
and closed to AI assistance.

You are responsible for the analytical specification, the verification, the
interpretation, and the final recommendation. Claude is a capable junior
analyst, not the decision maker. You must be able to explain any work you
submit.
